source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Collect information from all parties involved.
3. Take photographs of the scene and injuries if possible.
4. Fill out the accident report form diligently.
5. Record the date, time, and location of the incident.
6. Provide detailed descriptions of what happened leading up to the accident.
7. Document the injuries sustained and the names of the injured parties.
8. Include names and contact information for witnesses.
9. Describe the immediate actions taken (e.g., first aid, emergency services called).
10. Note the equipment and/or substances involved at the time of the accident.
11. Record statements from the injured person(s) and witnesses to get their perspectives.
12. Indicate whether any unsafe conditions were recognized after the incident occurred.
13. Attach all relevant medical reports and diagnostic test results.
14. Include the supervisor’s statement about the incident, if applicable.
15. Record any corrective actions that have been or will be taken.
16. Archive all documents
